environment.description: EKS pod running as deployment 'file-service' in namespace 'prod'. Container runs as UID 1000 with default securityContext (no readOnlyRootFilesystem). Pod uses emptyDir volume mounted at /var/data/reports. The container filesystem includes standard Linux paths (/etc/passwd, /proc, etc.). No network policy restricting egress. pgBouncer sidecar in transaction pooling mode with prepared_statement_mode=auto. Service exposed via ClusterIP, accessed by internal services through Envoy sidecar (Istio mesh) with permissive mTLS.
